judgments.reason: The PhysioNet record 'You Snooze You Win: The PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2018' is the original release of this PSG arousal dataset, with matching title and authors (Ghassemi et al.).
judgments.paper_title: You Snooze You Win: The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2018

judgments.reason: The Challenge overview paper by the same authors describes the 1,983 PSG recordings (994 training, 989 test) that make up this dataset, which was created for that Challenge.
judgments.paper_title: You Snooze, You Win: The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2018

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to curate this dataset, not a paper describing the PhysioNet 2018 PSG data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/standard extension to BIDS used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing the PhysioNet 2018 PSG data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
